name: Pixel Swap
description: Container that swaps between two pieces of content through a grid of springy pixel squares revealing the second layer, triggered by hover or click, with selectable reveal patterns.
contents: Two stacked content layers (firstContent and secondContent) filling an aspect-ratio frame
Clip-path mask built from a grid of animated pixel squares
behavior: Pixels grow with a spring (bounce) to reveal the second layer and shrink to restore the first
Reveal order follows the pattern prop, with optional randomness; pointer pattern radiates from the cursor entry or exit point
Plays an intro reveal of the first content on mount, waiting up to 3s for images to load
Hover trigger reacts to mouse and pen, touch and keyboard focus toggle it; click trigger toggles on click, Enter or Space
Can be controlled through active and onActiveChange
Skips animation and swaps instantly with prefers-reduced-motion
editableByProps: Both content layers, any React nodes such as images or cards
Reveal pattern, pixel size, gap, corner radius, start scale, spin, timing, randomness and bounce
Trigger mode, intro, initial and controlled state, aspect ratio, class and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise or lower the pixel count cap

fixed: Needs exactly two content layers; any trigger value other than hover or click gives no interaction (use active prop)
Pixel grid is capped at 600 cells, pixels are enlarged automatically on large areas
Minimum pixelSize is 8 and minimum pixelDuration is 60ms; values are clamped
Uses CSS clip-path path() on layers, redrawn every animation frame
Root is focusable (tabIndex 0) when trigger is hover or click
Frame is w-full with overflow hidden, size set by aspectRatio
Intro plays only when intro is true and initial state is not active
Client-only component ('use client'), relies on Tailwind classes
